description: state.json's own currentPhase is still "3" (impl-review), and phaseHistory has no "3"->"5" (or "5"->"6") transition anywhere for sprint 2 -- the only "to":"5" and "to":"6" entries in the entire phaseHistory array belong to sprint 1 (timestamps 2026-07-07T18:44 and 2026-07-07T19:25, both before sprint 2 was opened at 2026-07-07T19:30).
